note: 3D step 1 (23 Nov night): the captain's cabin at sunset. World axes: x right, y away from the lens, z up, metres. The stern windows in the back wall (y 3.2); the low sun comes in through them toward the lens. Each shot's camera drifts from 'from[0]' to 'from[1]' over the shot (eased), looking at 'at'; focus on a figure's head or a point.

shots.what: full figure, from the front: bent over the chart table, his hand on the papers; the sweep starts
a deliberate close-up, chest and up, from his left, low: his head comes up and he shouts "Boy!" with his mouth wide open
full figure, low three-quarter from his right: arms out wide, leaning in: "where is my"
a medium shot (head to thigh), high and near-frontal: leaning in, his finger jabbing toward the boy, his eyes on him: "treasure map?" (the caption over his legs)
the boy full, from the captain's own eyes (his point of view, so the captain is not in the picture), the cabin's side wall behind the boy: he points at the boots: "You're standing"
a deliberate close-up of the boy, chest up, from his right, low: he looks up at the captain and grins: "on it, Captain"
close on his boots on the map, his hands hanging at the hem (as in D1): the right boot lifts in a knee raise and the red X under it shows
full figure from the front (as E sees his boots): he looks down at the boot he holds up over the X; his face starts to go red
his whole face close, both eyes and the mouth in the picture: red, sweat on his cheek, a sheepish grin
